user.title: Connect to your X Air mixer
user.description: Enter the IPv4 address or hostname of your XR18 or X18. Home Assistant must be able to reach the mixer over UDP.

reconfigure.title: Change the mixer connection
reconfigure.description: Update the address of this mixer. Existing entity IDs are preserved.

error.cannot_connect: No valid response from the mixer. Check its address, network connection and UDP port (normally 10024).
error.unsupported_model: This integration supports Behringer XR18 and X18 mixers.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant logs.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The mixer connection has been updated.

init.title: Mixer controls
init.description: Enter one stored snapshot per line, for example 1=Speech or 2=Music. Valid slots are 1-64. Leave empty for no snapshot scenes. Names are local labels; create and save snapshots in X Air Edit first. Enabling bus sends adds 96 volume controls.

error.invalid_snapshots: Enter unique slots from 1 to 64, one per line, optionally followed by =Name (up to 80 characters).

recall_snapshot.name: Recall snapshot
recall_snapshot.description: Recall an internal mixer snapshot. This can change the entire mix. Empty slots may be ignored by the mixer.

slot.name: Snapshot slot
slot.description: The stored snapshot slot, from 1 to 64.
